# Contribution Guide

Contributions to HorizonFlow are welcome through issues and pull requests in this repository.

Before submitting a pull request:

1. Keep changes focused and consistent with the existing project structure.
2. Add or update tests for behavioural changes.
3. Run `composer test`, `composer lint`, and `npm run build` when relevant.
4. Explain the user-facing impact and any compatibility considerations.

Changes intended for Laravel Horizon itself should be proposed to the [upstream repository](https://github.com/laravel/horizon) instead.
